s01: Good morning, my friend! (pause) Yesterday we got ready for school. (pause) Today we sing songs. (pause) And we listen to stories!
veg: Let us meet some vegetables! (pause) Tap each one. (pause) Say its name with me.
veg-1: Pechay. (pause) It has big green leaves!
veg-2: Bawang. (pause) In English, garlic. (pause) It is white!
veg-3: Luya. (pause) In English, ginger. (pause) It is brown and bumpy!
song: Look at this little house. (pause) It is a bahay kubo. (pause) It has a big garden! (pause) Let us sing about it. (pause) Tap a line, or tap the big button to sing it all.
song-3: Singkamas at talong, sigarilyas at mani,
find-veg: Can you find the vegetables? (pause) Listen. (pause) Then tap!
find-veg-q1: Where is the garlic? The bawang?
find-veg-q2: Where is the ginger? The luya?
find-veg-q3: Where is the pechay? The one with green leaves?
move: Please stand up! (pause) Let us sing and move. (pause) Touch each part of your body with me!
t1: Story time! (pause) This is Turtle. (pause) And this is Monkey. (pause) One day, they find a banana plant. (pause) They cut it in two. (pause) Monkey takes the top. (pause) Turtle takes the bottom, with the roots.
t2: Monkey laughs at Turtle. (pause) Ha ha! My part has big leaves! (pause) But Turtle plants her part in the ground. (pause) She waters it every day.
t-mid-q1: Who planted the banana plant and watered it every day?
t-mid-q1-yes: Yes! Turtle planted it and watered it. (pause) Let us see what happens!
t3: Monkey hangs his part on a tree. (pause) But it has no roots. (pause) It dries up. (pause) It does not grow at all.
t4: But Turtle's plant grows tall. (pause) It grows yellow bananas! (pause) Turtle is kind. (pause) Turtle is patient. (pause) That is why she has bananas.
t-check: Let us think about the story.
t-check-q1-yes: Yes! Turtle was kind and patient. (pause) And she got bananas!
p1: Here is another story. (pause) The Legend of the Pineapple. (pause) Long ago, there was a girl named Pina. (pause) Pina did not like to help her mother.
p2a: One day, her mother is sick. (pause) Please cook for us, Pina, she says. (pause) But Pina says, I cannot find the pot! (pause) I cannot find the spoon! (pause) She does not even look.
p-mid-q1: Did Pina really look for the pot?
p-mid-q1-yes: Right! Pina did not look. (pause) The pot was right there!
p3: Her mother is very tired. (pause) She says, I wish you had many eyes, (pause) so you can find things!
p4: The next day, Pina is gone. (pause) In the garden, a new plant grows. (pause) Its fruit has many, many eyes! (pause) It is the pineapple. (pause) The pinya!
p-check: What does the story teach us?
p-check-q1: What should we do at home?
p-check-q1-yes: Yes! We help at home. (pause) Every little help is a big help!
verse: Our Bible verse is, (pause) Honor your father and your mother. (pause) We honor them when we help at home.
verse-verse: Honor your father and your mother. (pause) Exodus twenty, verse twelve.
done: Hooray! (pause) You sang Bahay Kubo. (pause) You moved your body. (pause) And you listened to two stories. (pause) See you tomorrow!

fx-cheer-2: I am happy to learn with you!
